_comment: PlantVision houseplant classifier — disease-F1 primary metric on the indoor real-world validation set

training.augmentations: indoor: WB shift (warm/cool), glare, defocus/motion blur, JPEG, ISP-imitation, soft shadows. Strong hue/solarize disabled.
training.isolated_val_slice: plantvillage_transfer (background-bias monitor; never used for train)
training.calibration: temperature scaling on indoor val NLL
training.quantization: dynamic INT8 on MatMul for student
training.diagnostic_baseline: DINOv2-S frozen + linear probe (5-8 epochs, batch 256, no MixUp/CutMix)

ood._score_note: MSP is unreliable when temperature scaling drives logits low; MaxLogit (Hendrycks 2019) is robust and bias-free under T<<1. Production combines: detector confidence + calibrated classifier confidence + MaxLogit OOD score.
ood.fallback_score: GEN (Liu CVPR 2023) for ViT branches if added
